heroHeadline: Ben-Gvir Orders Oct 7 'Horror Video' Screened to 175 Detained Flotilla Activists; IDF Strikes Continue on Ceasefire Day 203 — Day 936
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On April 30, 2026 (Day 936), Israeli National Security Minister Ben-Gvir ordered the 43-minute IDF documentary of the October 7, 2023 attacks — the 'horror video' — screened to 175 international activists detained after Israel's navy intercepted the Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters off Crete; Ben-Gvir visited the detention facility calling the activists 'terrorists helping murderers.' Israel intercepted at least 21 of 58+ flotilla vessels and redirected them to Ashdod. Turkey condemned the interception as 'an act of piracy'; Italy called it 'unlawful.' Also on April 30, IDF strikes killed at least 5 in Gaza City; the military opened an investigation and expressed regret. Cumulative Palestinian death toll since October 7, 2023 exceeds 72,600+ killed (OCHA/Gaza MoH); 820+ Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. Phase Two disarmament negotiations remain in deep deadlock — all Board of Peace deadlines have passed. The Israeli Supreme Court gave the Netanyahu government until July 1, 2026 to establish a suitable October 7 investigation framework; 72% of Israelis favor an independent inquiry (Hebrew University poll, Apr 26).
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, WAFA, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are official Israeli counts; Hamas-theater figures are separately noted and contested. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. Cumulative conflict dead (Oct 7, 2023 – Apr 2026): 72,600+ Palestinians per OCHA/Gaza MoH/WAFA. Ceasefire in effect since Oct 2025; 2,400+ violations documented by Gaza GMO — Palestinians killed since ceasefire: 820+ as of Apr 30, 2026. Gaza reconstruction cost: $71.4B per UN-EU-World Bank joint assessment (Apr 21, 2026). Apr 27: IDF releases final Holit probe — kibbutz left without IDF reinforcement for 6h53m on Oct 7. Apr 29: IDF kills Iyad Shambari, Hamas Military Intelligence Operations Dept chief, Oct 7 planner. Apr 30: Ben-Gvir orders Oct 7 horror video screened to 175 detained flotilla activists at Ashdod; High Court gives government until Jul 1 to set Oct 7 investigation framework.
